entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the account?
Alex Chen. Order number is VF78-21-B. Look, I don't need to troubleshoot anything, I just want to send it back.
I understand. I've got your order right here. Just for my records, could you tell me what specifically the issue is? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not for me. I found it hard to use, the app connection is confusing. I read the user manual and everything, but I just expected more from it. Can I return it, yes or no?
Okay, one moment while I check the purchase date for you. Let's see... it looks like it was delivered 34 days ago, on December 15th.

No problem at all. You're well within the 90-day return window. I've just authorized the return for you, Alex. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Great. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
